steps.text: 1. The Tourist opens the Places tab on the Explore page. A1.
2. The system shows the list of places that belong to public tours. E1.

exceptions.text: E1. No places yet → empty list.

steps.text: 3. The Tourist opens a place's details.
4. The Tourist taps "Add to itinerary". E2.

exceptions.text: E2. Not signed in → "Sign in to save places…" and go to Sign in (UC#01), then come back to continue adding.

steps.text: 5. The system opens a picker with the Tourist's itineraries and a button to create a new one. E3.

exceptions.text: E3. Itinerary name empty or too long → "Please name the itinerary" / "Itinerary name has at most 120 characters".

steps.text: 6. The Tourist picks an itinerary or creates a new one (enters a name).
7. The system adds the place at the end of the itinerary and stores a snapshot of the place's name and coordinates. E4.

exceptions.text: E4. The place no longer belongs to a public tour → 404 "Place is not available to add to an itinerary".

steps.text: 8. The Tourist opens the itinerary to order it. A2.
9. The system shows the map, the total distance, the estimated walking time and the distance of each leg.
10. The Tourist shares or starts following the itinerary (UC#08). A3, A4.

exceptions.text: E5. The itinerary does not exist (404), belongs to someone else (403), the place is not in the itinerary (404) or the data is invalid (400) → an error is shown.

steps: A1. Find and filter places by keyword, city, place type.
A2.1. Reorder places with the up / down buttons; the distance is recomputed.
A2.2. Remove a place at once, with an "Undo" button.
A2.3. Rename the itinerary (in the editor or in "My itineraries").
A2.4. Delete the whole itinerary after confirming "Delete itinerary"; the share link stops working.
A2.5. "Add places": open Explore, tap ＋ to add directly to the itinerary, "Done" to go back.
A3. Download the itinerary offline: download a package with the itinerary's places (as in UC#03).
A4.1. Create the share link /shared/:token (the code is reused if it exists), Copy button.
A4.2. Revoke sharing: the old link stops working; sharing again creates a new code.
A4.3. The recipient opens the link to view it (no sign-in needed) and follows it (UC#08 A2).
